ccfa_positioning: CCF-A-style strong evidence-chain discipline: machine-checkable provenance, claim boundaries, hash-linked raw-to-derived artifacts, reproducibility commands, and explicit limitations. This is not a venue acceptance guarantee.

non_claims: CCF-A-style evidence discipline is not a CCF-A acceptance guarantee
true real-malware validation remains blocked until external quarantine evidence exists
surrogate samples are repository-authored safe reimplementations
Mirai-reference samples are non-network synthetic reference behaviors
no mature detector or classifier-accuracy claim
no complete semantic reconstruction claim under p0a arg-mem-disabled tracing

limitations.impact: Surrogate run has board/raw UART and sample artifacts, but no separate Linux boot log under results/board for that run_id; see docs/results/evidence/35t-surrogate-boot-provenance-20260524 for the recorded blocker and capture runbook.
The strong chain supports surrogate and non-network reference behavior only; true real-malware PASS still requires external quarantine artifacts.
The p0a trace profile proves syscall/control-flow behavior but intentionally does not provide complete fd/path or process-tree reconstruction.
Raw UART, decoded traces, ELFs, and boot logs are hash-linked local artifacts; public release remains hash/sanitized unless raw escrow is approved.

paper_claim_evidence_table.claim_table_policy: Paper claims are only allowed when their machine-checkable evidence row is PASS. DEFERRED rows may be discussed as limitations or required follow-up, not as completed claims.

limitations: Primary package is synthetic-behavior 35T evidence, not true real-malware evidence.
claims.paper_wording: The primary 35T evidence package is hash-manifested and locally reproducible.

limitations: Repository-authored safe reimplementations retain behavior shape only.
claims.paper_wording: Three DarthRa-derived safe surrogates pass the Artix-7 35T board validation gate.

limitations: Network-required Mirai behavior remains excluded from this non-network claim.
claims.paper_wording: Three non-network Mirai-reference behavior simulations pass the Artix-7 35T board validation gate.

limitations: Lineage is behavior-derived and explicitly not payload-equivalence evidence.
claims.paper_wording: Six board-tested behaviors have explicit real-malware-derived lineage, risk removal, and non-claim boundaries.

limitations: Ratios are descriptive; this is not an advanced QEMU-plugin/eBPF comparison.
claims.paper_wording: The six real-malware-derived behaviors have same-set host, strace, QEMU, and 35T board medians recorded.

limitations: A deferred status means the paper must not claim a surrogate run-scoped Linux boot log until that log is captured.
claims.paper_wording: The surrogate run records boot provenance status and explicitly names the run-scoped boot-log blocker.

limitations: No true real-malware board-execution evidence is claimed in this package.
claims.paper_wording: True real-malware validation remains a blocked boundary, not a PASS claim.
